title: El tope
desc: August 1, and the whole city moves at once
setting: Seven in the morning, thousands of people, and Marcos has told you twice not to let go of him.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: No te me soltés, vos. Aquí se pierde uno.
steps.en: Do not let go of me. People get lost here.

options.es: Dale. Si me pierdo, ¿dónde nos vemos?
options.en: Right. If I get lost, where do we meet?
options.feedback: Accepted and planned for the thing he just warned you about. Sensible without being nervous.

options.en: All right, I am right behind you.
options.feedback: Fine, and in that crowd behind lasts about forty seconds.

options.en: Do not worry, I know my way.
options.feedback: You have been to this city for four years and never to this. He has been coming since he was six.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Mirá aquel. Ese va pagando una promesa.
steps.en: Look at that one. He is paying a promise.

options.en: Is that why he is smeared in oil?
options.feedback: You noticed the thing that matters and asked. He has been waiting all morning for somebody to ask.
You do not see, and he knows it. Ask.
Said out loud in that crowd about a man paying for his child's health.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Se lo untan y caminan los diez días.
steps.en: They smear it on and walk the ten days.

options.es: Chocho. Diez días con eso encima.
options.en: Chocho. Ten days with that on.
options.feedback: The right word and the right amount of respect in it. That is somebody reacting, not observing.
True. Flat where a reaction was called for.

options.es: Eso no puede ser bueno para la piel.
options.en: That cannot be good for the skin.
options.feedback: A health note in the middle of somebody's faith.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.en: And you, do you have a promise?

options.feedback: Answered honestly and turned it back. In that crowd it is a real question and he may answer it.

options.es: No, yo no soy de eso.
options.en: No, I am not one for that.
options.feedback: Honest. It also closes the door he was opening.

options.en: I do not believe in promises.
options.feedback: Half the people around you are paying one. Save the position for another day.
